relations.text: 新ガス管の輸送枠(日量50万MMBtu)を確保
relations.text_en: Firm capacity on its new Hugh Brinson gas pipeline

source.label: Matador 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We also secured firm transportation on Energy Transfer's Hugh Brinson Pipeline, which is expected to come online in the fourth quarter of 2026, to move 500,000 MMBtu per day of natural gas production out of the Permian Basin to East Texas and markets along the Gulf Coast where demand and pricing have historically been significantly higher
